notes.title: Policy Changes For Free Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/04e01f130a8599d0f70684fc6a79f864b017f9a3.png[/img]

Greetings from PsychoFlux Entertainment!

We're going to talk about the change of our pricing policy, for most of the free games we're servicing.

We have been servicing a lot of free games by offering main game for free, with an $1 empty DLC for donations; so the users who are satisfied by the game are able to support us and the developers by purchasing the DLC, which also makes the game stay in your Steam library.

However, some of the players told us that the game won't stay in their library even after purchasing the DLC, so they had to visit the store page to install it again. Thus we're going to make some changes to solve this problem and give some advantages to the purchasers.

—

[h1]Steam Edition[/h1]
Free games will be switched to Steam Edition, which will cost about $1. [b]If you already purchased the Donationware DLC, you will automatically receive the Steam Edition of the game.[/b]

Also, games that support a leaderboard will also start to support Steam Leaderboard, so you can upload your score at both of them. Steam Cloud and Steam Achievements will be the same as before. We're planning to update the games that are not supporting these features, so please allow us some time.

And maybe we might add Steam Trading Cards, too!


[h1]New Free Version[/h1]
An alternative free version will be added on Steam to compensate former version. Download button will be displayed on the store page, along with the purchase button for the Steam Edition. This new free version won't support any Steamworks features such as Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Leaderboard, etc.

Achievements that you already unlocked won't go away, but you won't be able to unlock new ones. Your score will only be uploaded on the default leaderboard.


[h1]Donationware DLC[/h1]
These DLCs will be gone from the store. As we mentioned, holder of these DLCs will automatically receive the Steam Edition game.

—

These changes will be applied within a day or two, to the games listed below. Please leave your comments if you have any questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/502130/Ctrl_CV/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/735570/Project_Rhombus/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/739260/Golden_Hornet/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/891130/SUPER_FLAIL/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/906390/Return/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978790/Frantic_Dimension/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/978800/Rolling_Bird/

notes.title: 1.5.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Bullet Case is now an obtainable item and will give you 1000 points when obtained.
[*] Minor bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.1 Patch Note
notes.content:
The room where the enemies remain is now marked in red on the minimap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34091025/84d45dc1c719151269e860aa2d5e7b908e487b7d.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.5.0 Patch Note
notes.content: Adjusted the color of the wall slightly darker.

notes.title: 1.4.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Pixelated the laser to add more retro feel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34091025/d95f966a3dac49997654a830748506e510fa5950.png[/img]
[*] Barrigates spawned when the player moves to the next room will not disappear until the player is far enough away from them.
[*] Yadcian Shock Troopers will now predict a player's movement whenever they fire a weapon.
[*] Now the Robot Guards will react faster.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.7 & 1.4.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]1.4.7[/h1]
[list][*] The graphics of the Evil Faces will vary depending on their health.
[*] Adjusted the player's laser sound effect to be less noisy.[/list]

[h1]1.4.8[/h1]
[list][*] Reduced the number of enemies spawned in later dungeons.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Reduced the difficulty of the game slightly.
[*]The scoreboard has been reset.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]The way the enemy Evil Face moves has been changed.
[*]Now the player character becomes invincible for a while(2 frames long) when it moves from one room to another.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.4 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where you would hit by the Evil Face while moving to the next room, when it almost caught up with you.

notes.title: 1.4.3 Patch Note
notes.content:
The time it takes for the Evil Faces(enemy unit that appears when you explore 35 or more rooms) to spawn has been adjusted as follows.
[list][*][b]Depth 1:[/b] 2 seconds
[*][b]Depth 2:[/b] 1.75 seconds
[*][b]Depth 3 or deeper:[/b] 1.5 seconds (same as in v1.4.1 or earlier)[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now when the player is running away, Treasure Ghosts will be regenerated in the room where the player is, rather than chasing the player over the rooms.
[*]Now when you've finished exploring every rooms, it'll take a little longer for Evil Faces to spawn.[/list]

notes.title: 1.4.1 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where you couldn't attack the Core when you're playing the game with the controller.

notes.title: 1.4.0 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where you couldn't destroy the shield of the Cores when you're playing the game with the controller.

notes.title: 1.3.9 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed some code to address the bug where you couldn't destroy the Core and its shield.

notes.title: 1.3.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Reduced the attack speed of the Core.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Evil Face would appear on the opposite side of the screen, when it's hanging on the edge of the screen.[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.7 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an error that occurred when the Treasure Keeper was hit by player's attack, or when player fired a weapon right after entering a room.

notes.title: 1.3.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed a critical error that occurred when the Bullet Case was destroyed.
[*]Now when you collide with enemies and hit them with your weapon at the same time, your attack will always get a priority.[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Now you'll get a Smartbomb when you acquired 10 treasures.
[*]We have slightly lowered the game's difficulty.
[*]Now you'll get bonus Smartbombs based on the Depth you selected when you're started the game.[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where you couldn't select Exit on the main menu with your controller.
[*]Some optimization-related updates has been applied.[/list]
